reason: I just cancelled a $20 planner because it never really sat on top of my work calendar, and this pitch doesn't say a word about Google or Outlook sync. I might poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying for a new app with zero Reddit threads or YouTube comparisons against Sunsama or Akiflow.
objection: My calendar lives in my company's Google or Outlook account. If Moduo can't reliably sync both ways with it, and get past IT's permissions, the time blocks are fiction and the whole done/push/shrink loop is useless to me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real two-way sync with a work Google or Outlook calendar, plus a few independent reviews or comparison videos from people who switched from Sunsama or Motion and stuck with it for months.
